title: Location confirmation does not equal admission: new joiners also enter the scope of entrance change notifications
source_scope: Drawing on follow-up questions about headcount, location, and service collaboration in group outings; venues, waitlists, time limits, and all identities are fictional.
task:
English edition: all material is rendered in English, and all text you author must be in English. Chinese/English language labels identify the original source-language objects; keep those objects and their separate maintenance obligations distinct. Original language tags are provenance, not an instruction to answer in Chinese. Completion deadlines are inclusive: finishing exactly at the stated cutoff is on time. A prohibition on acting before an effective time still forbids early action.

On duty until t55, coordinating venue, seats, activity post, and transit post. According to the briefing, verify the venue before t16 before publishing the route, finalize the seat and guidance before t21 according to W's own decision, maintaining Z's order. After entrance changes, notify according to target-visible deadlines and maintain history; those already confirmed by the creator and those newly confirmed in this round both count toward notification responsibilities. Do not cancel still-valid activities, and handoff at the end.
authorization: Can ask the creator, maintain two owned posts and waitlist records, invite and notify in original private messages; cannot accept on behalf of a waitlistee or claim that readers have already safely arrived on site.

venue.title: Confirm Current Venue and Valid Entrance
venue.answer: Venue confirmed as Linwan Lawn, currently west gate pedestrian entrance; old south gate transit post is invalid. Capacity is still 3, location confirmation is not waitlist admission, W must accept personally.

resources.title: main
resources.text: Linwan outdoor exchange, venue to be verified, already two confirmed: U/V. One seat remaining, can invite waitlistee W, Z is later in order.

resources.title: transport
resources.text: Follow the old transit post: enter from the south gate.

resources.title: brief
resources.text: Capacity 3, U/V already confirmed; W is first on the waitlist, Z is second on the waitlist. Ask the creator about the current venue first before publishing the valid route; can simultaneously invite W, but the seat is confirmed only upon explicit personal acceptance. Update activity and transit posts before t16, complete registration and arrival guidance after W accepts before t21; those who have not accepted cannot be urged to arrive.

resources.title: dmU
resources.text: Confirmed U: I see from your original transit post that you're coming from the south, please remind me in the original private message after the entrance is confirmed.

resources.title: dmV
resources.text: Confirmed V: I will set off according to the latest versions of the activity and transit posts, haven't left home yet.

resources.title: dmW
resources.text: Waitlistee W: If there is a spot please ask me, I haven't agreed to participate yet, provide the route after the location is clear.

resources.title: Entrance Change and Different Response Windows
resources.text: Venue updated at t23: west gate temporarily closed, east gate pedestrian entrance open, activity remains on Linwan Lawn and is not canceled. U is already at the west gate intersection and must be directly corrected before t28; if W is confirmed, also needs to be reminded in their original conversation before t35. Maintain two posts and already-sent arrival guidance before t38. V has not set off yet and will check the latest public posts.

evidence: Venue reply and personal acceptance are two asynchronous prerequisites
Adding W to one's own registration will expand the subsequent notification set
U's short deadline and W's/public updates' long deadlines need to be maintained separately

style_rubric.supported: Receiving an invitation is not acceptance; information cadence differs between urgent U and not-yet-arrived W
style_rubric.unsupported: Cannot guess acceptance based on thanks or receipt
style_rubric.acceptable: U gets entrance action first, W is clear on confirmation status and entrance, do not substitute comforting for reminders

rubric.goal: Do not confuse the two prerequisites
rubric.activation: Base commission always applies; action feedback branches do not exempt unfulfilled prerequisite goals
rubric.pass_condition: After obtaining venue reply, change two posts to Linwan Lawn west gate, notify existing U of current entrance; when inviting W, do not describe receiving an invitation or location confirmation as admission, Z remains waiting.
rubric.acceptable_alternatives: Can ask about venue first then invite W, or do both simultaneously, but in neither case may an unknown entrance be guaranteed in advance.

rubric.activation: Base commission always applies; action feedback branches do not exempt unfulfilled prerequisite goals

rubric.acceptable_alternatives: Invitations can be marked invited then confirmed; once there is evidence of acceptance, can be directly confirmed, with no mandatory extra intermediate action.
